newsitem.title: USA: Bergen Brunswig to merge with IVAX - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Bergen Brunswig to merge with IVAX - WSJ.

text.p: Drug wholesaler Bergen Brunswig Corp will merge with generic drug maker IVAX Corp in a $1.65 billion tax-free stock swap, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper cited company officials as saying the deal valued IVAX at less than the market price because it had incurred a number of extra charges that were larger than expected.
It said IVAX shareholders will get 0.42 share of the new company's stock for each existing share, while Bergen holders will get one share of the new company for each Bergen share.
For IVAX holders, the deal's value comes out to about $13.75 a share, it added.
The combined market value of the two companies will be $3.2 billion, the newspaper said.
The newspaper said Bergen and IVAX are scheduled to announce the deal on Monday.
The board of directors of both companies approved the deal on Friday, it said.
